messages:
maria: FYI I flipped the mini-block-pool eager-reuse flag in staging and saw a ~12% regression in tokens/s on paged-attn 13B. Posting the trimmed flame + traces here to get eyes on it.

raj: can you paste the top flame callers and kernel counts? sounds like kernel selection churn or fragmentation.

maria: pasted relevant perf blowout below. notable things: more small-block kernel launches, higher cudaMalloc retries, and compaction runs correlated with allocation failures.

sam: that pattern usually points at workspace sizing + reuse policy interacting poorly. eager reuse puts small blocks back into the mini pool which then gets used by small-block kernel path more often. could be moving the sequence/len mix toward smaller kernels.

maria: perf snapshot: 
```
PagedAttn::forward  48.3%
  blockmgr::alloc  18.5%
    cudaMallocRetry 9.2%
  small_block_kernel 12.1%
  kv_cache::promote 6.8%
```

ingrid: another config change in the same deploy: max batch window bumped to 60ms. that increases coalescing across requests and seems to shift seq-length distribution, leading to more small-block kernel choices.

raj: do we have compaction traces? if eager-reuse causes frequent repools/compacts, the compaction cost becomes a tail killer.

maria: compaction sample: 
```
[blockmgr] compact start stream=3 reason=alloc_fail
repool block 256B -> reused
compact end cost_ms=11
```

sam: 11ms per compact is significant at p95 QPS. if compaction runs every ~200ms on busy streams it's basically subtracting cycles from useful compute.

ingrid: check kv cache churn too. If promotes/evicts increase because blocks are fragmenting KV entries across many tiny blocks, you'll see a lot more allocation churn.

maria: confirmed: kv_cache promote/evict cycles are ~4x baseline in the canary. suggests more scattered KV entries and higher internal fragmentation.

raj: proposed quick mitigations: 
- revert eager-reuse in mini pool (fast rollback)
- increase workspace target to bias away from small-block kernels
- add compaction backoff/rate-limit for streams that recently compacted

ingrid: I'll add compaction-rate-per-stream and kernel-switch counters to the console so we can quantify impact across tenants.

sam: alternative experiment: keep eager-reuse but raise the mini-block reuse threshold to <=128B (don't reuse blocks between 128B-512B). That keeps medium blocks in a separate flow and reduces fragmentation for KV entries.

maria: plan: roll canary with revert+workspace bump, then run synthetic perf job. if that recovers we can iterate on the reuse threshold instead of full revert. @perf-bot can you schedule a full kernel+compaction trace run after deploy?

perf-bot: scheduled paged-attn-13B-canary @ 1976530178. collecting kernel traces, alloc/compaction timeline, and flamegraphs.

raj: once we have the canary flame compare, look specifically at: small_block_kernel count, cudaMallocRetry occurrences, compaction frequency per-stream, kv promote/evict rate, and kernel-switch transitions per request. those will tell us whether workspace or reuse is the dominant cause.

maria: noted. I'll post the canary results here in ~20m with before/after diff. thanks all.
